limitations: The depth-chart feed is a role and roster proxy; it is not a frozen game-day active roster.
Historical injury rows for 2025 have no date_modified timestamps, so injury eligibility cannot be reconstructed as of kickoff and no claim of fully roster-valid calibration is made.
The 2024 official depth-chart file is weekly without a publication timestamp; its matching-week roster filter is exploratory.
This evaluates target-role marginals, not participant selection, full-game outcomes, target counts, scoring, or win probabilities.
The 2024 sweep is used to select shrinkage strength; only 2025 is the final untouched chronological comparison.

method.baselines: league pooled situation distribution and existing SLC team-cell distribution shrunk toward league by 20 rows
method.depth_chart_filter: 2024 official weekly offense depth chart for matching week; 2025 latest official chart timestamp strictly before game-date UTC. Score subsets by normalizing all distributions over listed RB/WR/TE groups. The feed does not provide frozen injury eligibility.
method.uncertainty: 1000 paired game-cluster bootstrap draws; percentile 95% intervals

tuning.selection_rule: maximize 2024 all-target log-loss improvement over the team-conditioned baseline; this choice is carried unchanged to the 2025 report
